task: Open /home/user/Documents/surface.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 1500 points on a curved paraboloid surface with no per-point normals. Compute per-point normals (default options are fine). Then export the cloud — including the computed normals — as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/surface_normals.ply. The output must have 1500 points and must include nx, ny, nz properties.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/surface.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 1500 points on a curved paraboloid surface with no per-point normals. Use Edit > Normals > Compute to compute per-point normals (default options are fine). Then export the cloud — including the computed normals — as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/surface_normals.ply. The output must have 1500 points and must include nx, ny, nz properties.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
